entities.name: Yuri Gagarin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Soviet cosmonaut (1934-1968) who became the first human in space on April 12, 1961, orbiting Earth in Vostok 1 in 108 minutes. His flight represented the pinnacle of the Soviet space program and a defining moment of the Space Race, demonstrating that humans could survive in space and inspiring generations of space exploration.
